text:
ria: FYI a customer flagged what looks like two charges for the same tokens when a stream got truncated and the client reconnected. They see both a provisional row and then a confirmed row for overlapping token ranges.

dan: can you drop the session/request ids? is this on model-x or a routing fallback?
ia: req=inq-91 / sess=xyz-331. model was model-x, route failed over to fallback region, client reconnected and server resumed with a replayed prefix.

lee: pulled logs for xyz-331:
```
2026-03-05T09:12:10Z proxy: start session sess=xyz-331 provisional=200
2026-03-05T09:12:14Z runtime: stream-eof truncated=true emitted_prefix=80
2026-03-05T09:12:18Z proxy: handoff -> resume target=fallback model resume_prefix=80
2026-03-05T09:12:19Z ledger: insert_provisional sess=xyz-331 tokens=80 prov_tag=pt-aaa
2026-03-05T09:12:21Z ledger: insert_confirm sess=xyz-331 tokens=80
```

lee: looks like we created a provisional tag on resume but didn't clear the original provisional or tie confirms to the prov_tag so ledger shows 2x.

jon: agreed. two possible fixes: (1) make confirms reference the prov_tag so confirms update existing provisional row rather than insert a new confirmed row, or (2) make handoff invalidate old provisional rows when the prefix is re-emitted.

dan: (1) would need a prov_tag generated by the router at first token emission and carried through handoff. (2) is simpler but brittle if we miss races.

ria: UX concern: customers see both rows in billing UI and assume double billing. We should have a defensive console rule that collapses rows with same request id + overlapping token range for 24h while we fix server change.

jon: implementation plan suggestion:
- router: emit a short-lived provenance id (prov_tag) for each prefix range when first tokens are provisionally recorded.
- ledger: provisional rows store prov_tag. Confirm step will upsert by prov_tag (update provisional -> confirmed) if prov_tag exists. Fallback: if no prov_tag, keep existing behavior.
- reconciliation service: accept upsert events keyed by prov_tag; add migration to rebuild prov_tag index for recent 48h.

lee: telemetry: add counter billing.detected_overlapping_provisionals and histogram billing.confirm_latency_by_prov to catch regressions.

dan: console: show a single merged billing row for same prov_tag with a small note "merged provisional+confirm" and a link to raw ledger entries. keep raw mode for audits.

ria: low-risk rollout plan: feature-flag prov_tag generation in router; flip ledger upsert behind flag; console read-side can be deployed to merge when prov_tag present. then enable flags gradually by region.

jon: tests: unit tests for ledger.upsert_by_prov_tag, integration test simulating reconnect+resume that asserts one final charge row. add e2e that toggles flags.

billing-bot: created tracking ticket BILL-2026-102 and alert rule billing.duplicate_confirm > 5 per minute triggered.

ria: I'll open the router PR today. dan/lee can coordinate ledger changes; jon will own the recon changes; console work assigned to maria? (ping maria).

dan: noted. i'll add the metrics and a dashboard panel for provisional vs confirmed delta per hour.

ria: thanks everyone. if you see other sessions with duplicates, paste ids and i'll correlate.

lee: one more thought: long term we might want prefix-level idempotency tokens at the client protocol level so retries/reconnects can be clearly deduped earlier in the stack. adding to roadmap. :rocket:
